generatedFor: WO-058 — Triage ui/app/ files into migration effort buckets (largest remaining UI TypeScript conversion story)

methodology.scope: Every .js file under ui/app/ at the time of triage (479 files). The WO-058 description text (486 remaining files, 25 services, 38 models, 84 controllers, 173 routes, 488 components, 77 forms) was written when the story was drafted, before WO-034/048/049/050/051 landed and before other parallel-merged work already converted app/forms/** (77 files, all .ts), app/serializers/identity/** (5 files, all .ts), and app/services/auth.ts + 9 other services. This artifact reflects the actual current on-disk state, not the stale WO description counts.
methodology.patternDetection: Regex-based static analysis of each file's default export: `Mixin.create(` -> mixin; `export default class` -> octane-class; `.extend(` with `export default` -> classic-extend; `export default helper(`/`buildHelper(`/plain function export -> helper; everything else -> utility.
methodology.dependencyGraph: Built by parsing `import ... from '...'` specifiers in every .js AND .ts file under ui/app/, resolving relative imports and bare `vault/...` absolute imports (per ui/tsconfig.json paths mapping) to real files under app/, and counting unique resolving source files per target module. This counts only static import statements — it does NOT count Ember's implicit resolution (store.findRecord('foo') resolving to models/foo.ts, {{foo-bar}} template invocations, or DI service injection by name), which is why ember-data adapters/serializers/models can show a low or zero static dependencyCount while still being load-bearing. Wave assignment therefore layers a domain-priority override on top of the raw import graph (see waveAssignment) rather than relying on dependencyCount alone, unlike WO-023's ui/lib/core triage where intra-core static imports were a fair proxy for coupling.
methodology.waveAssignment: wave 1: category is one of models/adapters/serializers/services (ember-data + auth foundations consumed almost entirely via implicit DI/store resolution rather than static import, so they are pulled into wave 1 unconditionally per this WO's implementation_steps order), OR the file is secret-edit.js / parse-pki-cert.js (explicit high-blast-radius files named in the acceptance criteria), OR dependencyCount >= 5. wave 2: dependencyCount 1-4 (everything else, mostly routes/controllers/components consumed by other routes/controllers/components). wave 3: dependencyCount === 0 (leaf nodes — helpers, utils, standalone components/routes with no intra-app static importers — convert last).
